name: programmable-v4-builder
description: Design, build, review, and submit Programmable hooks, tokens, apps, games, services, and standalone settlement projects through Submit a Launch.

interface.shortDescription: Build a reviewable Programmable project from one prompt
interface.longDescription: Loads one portable skill that turns an idea or repository into the smallest complete Programmable system, checks its exact source and evidence, and prepares a draft-only application for 0xprogrammable/submit-launch without limiting unfamiliar products to known templates.
defaultPrompt: Use $programmable-v4-hook-builder to build and check my project, then prepare it for Submit a Launch.
